design_philosophy: Premium, high-density, tactile SaaS dashboard. Moves away from 'airy/bubbly' generic standard designs to a 'Swiss Brutalist' and 'Old Money Tech' hybrid. Prioritizes information density, sharp edges, monochromatic structure with highly deliberate accent highlights, and optical clarity. Tailored for Turkish language localization with proper font-support.
theme: High-Contrast Monochrome with Tactile Surfaces. Light/Dark mode togglable.

rules.language_support: MUST ensure fonts support Turkish characters (Latin Extended).
rules.general: Avoid font-bold for everything. Use font-medium for subtle emphasis. Use tracking-tight for all headings.

overview_page_redesign.philosophy: Command-Center / Editorial layout. AVOID the generic 4-card KPI + 2 donut chart layout. Embrace asymmetry, typography-as-UI, and dense data visualization.

layout_structure.grid: Use a staggered, asymmetric layout. E.g., A top section spanning full width, followed by an asymmetric 2-column split (e.g., lg:col-span-8 for Tasks, lg:col-span-4 for Activity/Workload).
layout_structure.spacing: Minimize padding between structural blocks. Use sharp 1px borders to separate sections instead of floating cards with gaps.

hero_greeting.description: Massive editorial headline that breaks standard dashboard conventions.
hero_greeting.typography: Cabinet Grotesk, text-5xl to text-6xl, font-light, tracking-tighter.
hero_greeting.layout: No containing card or padding box. Sits raw on the background canvas. E.g. 'Merhaba, Ahmet.' with a subtle text-zinc-500 date next to it.

key_metrics_ticker.description: Replaces standard KPI cards with a dense 'Status Ribbon' or 'Data Ticker'.
key_metrics_ticker.layout: A single horizontal row divided by 1px vertical borders (divide-x divide-zinc-200 dark:divide-zinc-800).
key_metrics_ticker.typography: Numbers: JetBrains Mono text-4xl or text-5xl font-light. Labels: Manrope text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest text-zinc-500.
key_metrics_ticker.visual: Instead of icons, rely purely on the stark contrast of large mono typography. For 'Geciken' (Overdue), tint the number slightly (e.g., text-rose-600/90).

status_distribution.description: NO DONUT CHARTS. Use an editorial 'Stacked Mono Bar' or 'Dot-Matrix Waffle Chart'.
status_distribution.layout: A single full-width horizontal stacked progress bar (h-3 or h-4) spanning the section.
status_distribution.visual: Segments are colored in monochromatic shades (Zinc-900, Zinc-600, Zinc-300) + one accent (Amber-500 for delayed). Above the bar, plot the exact percentages in JetBrains Mono alongside their labels.

workload_leaderboard.description: Ranked leaderboard rows for team workload.
workload_leaderboard.layout: Dense list. Avatar (w-6 h-6, rounded-none or sharp corners), User Name (text-sm Manrope).
workload_leaderboard.visual: Instead of a bar chart, use inline mono horizontal progress bars (h-1.5 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 with primary fill) representing task count. Right-aligned JetBrains Mono task count.

bana_atananlar_tasks.description: My Open Tasks - Asymmetric Left Column (e.g. 70% width).
bana_atananlar_tasks.layout: High-density data list. border-collapse with 1px border-b per row. py-2.5 or py-3 per row.
bana_atananlar_tasks.columns: Task Title (Manrope font-medium text-sm), Project Tag (border badge, text-[10px]), Due Date (JetBrains Mono text-xs).
bana_atananlar_tasks.interaction: Hover: subtle bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900/50 shift + slight x-axis nudge (translateX 4px via framer-motion or tailwind group-hover).

son_aktiviteler_feed.description: Activity Feed - Asymmetric Right Column (e.g. 30% width).
son_aktiviteler_feed.layout: A dense 'Terminal' style timeline feed. Connected by a 1px vertical dashed or solid line.
son_aktiviteler_feed.typography: Timestamps: JetBrains Mono text-[11px] text-zinc-500. Activity: Manrope text-xs leading-relaxed.
son_aktiviteler_feed.visual: Dots on the timeline should be sharp squares (w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-zinc-900 dark:bg-zinc-100) instead of standard circles.

framer_motion_rules.stagger_entrance: The massive greeting fades and slides down slightly (y: -10). The Ticker metrics reveal horizontally (opacity + x: -10) with a 0.1s stagger.
framer_motion_rules.lists: Tasks and timeline items should stagger in (opacity 0 to 1, y: 5 to 0) to feel like a high-tech terminal booting up.

overview_page_redesign.testing: All elements must have robust data-testid attributes (e.g., `data-testid="overview-greeting"`, `data-testid="metric-ticker-geciken"`, `data-testid="task-row-1"`).

spacing_and_density.philosophy: COMPACT and DENSE. Every pixel matters. Reduce unnecessary padding.
spacing_and_density.cards: p-4 or p-5 (not p-6). minimal gaps.
spacing_and_density.lists_and_tables: h-9 or h-10 rows. py-1.5 px-3 for cells.
spacing_and_density.buttons: h-8 px-3 text-xs or h-9 px-4 text-sm. rounded-md (6px radius).
spacing_and_density.sidebar: w-56 or w-60. Items are h-8 with text-sm.

layouts.app_shell: Left collapsible sidebar (fixed) + Sticky Topbar. Main content area must have a max-width for ultra-wide screens or span gracefully using grid.
layouts.kanban: Ghost columns (transparent bg, thin dashed border if empty), Cards are solid with 1px border. Tightly packed (gap-2).
layouts.task_drawer: Side sheet (w-[500px] to w-[600px]). Sticky header with actions, scrollable content, sticky footer for comments/budget summary.
layouts.settings_tabs: Vertical tabs on desktop (left side), compact list. Horizontal scrollable on mobile.

component_rules.cards: Cardless or Flat. NO soft drop shadows. Use 1px sharp borders (border-zinc-200 / border-zinc-800). bg-white dark:bg-[#121214].
component_rules.inputs_and_dropdowns: h-8 or h-9. bg-transparent. 1px border. Focus state must be a sharp 2px ring of primary color (zinc-900/zinc-50) or pure underline, no fuzzy shadows.
component_rules.tables: border-collapse. border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800/50. Hover state: subtle background shift.
component_rules.modals_drawers: Must use Glassmorphism for overlays (backdrop-blur-sm bg-black/40). Surface of the drawer must be solid, not glass.
component_rules.charts: Recharts. Use monochromatic palettes (shades of zinc/gray) with ONE accent color (e.g., Amber or Rose) to highlight anomalies. NO grid lines, or extremely faint dashed grid lines.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use for Sticky Topbar ONLY. backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 dark:bg-[#09090b]/70 + 1px bottom border. DO NOT use transparent background without blur if content scrolls underneath.
visual_enhancers.noise_texture: Apply a faint SVG noise texture (opacity 2-3%) fixed over the entire app shell background to create a premium tactile paper/matte feel.
visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: Use subtle animated left-border highlight for active Sidebar items or Task list active rows.

motion.transitions: Duration 150ms, ease-out. Target specific properties (e.g., transition-colors, transition-opacity), NEVER 'transition-all'.
motion.hover_states: Buttons and list items slightly darken/lighten background. NO scaling/translating up for dashboard items.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards. Do not use pure gray on gray.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements MUST have a visible focus ring.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="task-card-12"`).

images_and_icons.icons_library: @phosphor-icons/react (Weight: Regular or Duotone) OR lucide-react with strokeWidth={1.5}. Must feel crisp and technical.
images_and_icons.avatars: Small, compact (w-6 h-6 or w-8 h-8). Use high-quality UI faces or crisp initials.
images_and_icons.empty_states: Do not use generic illustrations. Use crisp, monochromatic Phosphor/Lucide icons layered with subtle background circles and exact Turkish copy.

instructions_to_main_agent: Read the `overview_page_redesign` object carefully. Implement the exact layout, typography, and framer-motion details outlined there for the Overview page.
Install required fonts (@fontsource/cabinet-grotesk, @fontsource/manrope, @fontsource/jetbrains-mono) via npm/yarn or add to Google Fonts import if not already present.
Use framer-motion for the staggered entrance on the dashboard as explicitly detailed.
DO NOT render a traditional 4-card grid and DO NOT render standard pie/donut charts. Build the 'Stacked Mono Bar' or 'Data Ticker' as instructed.
Ensure the Turkish language is hardcoded or supported seamlessly in the UI.
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or sticky headers without a blur and solid fallback.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, NOT fluffy drop shadows. Use 1px sharp borders.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only where instructed (Topbar).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Phosphor or Lucide.
Use 2-3x more spacing conceptually, but in this specific 'Compact' context, use tighter internal paddings with clear outer margins to define groups.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js/tsx
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
